attchmntText: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper advertisement published in Navbharat Times (Hindi Daily) and The Economic Times (English Daily) on November 12, 2026 in respect of the Extracts of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited published extracts of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was filed with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 12, 2026. Standalone total income was Rs. 964.86 crore, compared to Rs. 1,158.60 crore in the corresponding previous quarter. Standalone net loss after tax was Rs. 164.54 crore, versus a loss of Rs. 99.59 crore in the prior period. Consolidated total income stood at Rs. 970.79 crore, with a consolidated net loss after tax of Rs. 121.28 crore, compared to a loss of Rs. 105.25 crore previously. Basic earnings per share from continuing and discontinued operations was negative Rs. 0.21 on a standalone basis and negative Rs. 0.15 on a consolidated basis. The results include contributions from subsidiaries Bajaj Power Generation Pvt. Ltd., Bajaj Aviation Pvt. Ltd., Phenil Sugars Ltd., and Bajaj Hindusthan Singapore Pvt. Ltd.

attchmntText: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026 and sale / divestment of the Company's entire (100%) shareholding in Bajaj Hindusthan (Singapore) Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited approved the sale of its entire shareholding in wholly owned subsidiary Bajaj Hindusthan Singapore Private Limited to Altaqat Management Consultancies Co LLC in consortium with Dejavu FZ LLC. The total consideration is USD 62,61,887. The transaction is subject to necessary regulatory compliances. The company authorized the execution of the Share Purchase Agreement and other definitive documents. Following this sale, Bajaj Hindusthan Singapore Private Limited will cease to be a subsidiary. Two step-down subsidiaries in Indonesia, PT Jangkar Prima and PT Batu Bumi Persada, will also cease to be subsidiaries. The transaction is not a related party transaction. The buyers do not belong to the promoter group. Completion is expected within 180 days. The board meeting was held on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited reported unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 11, 2026. The company posted a net loss of 164.54 crore for the quarter, compared to a loss of 99.59 crore in the corresponding previous period. Revenue from operations stood at 962.48 crore for the quarter, down from 1,153.11 crore previously. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 341.59 crore against a loss of 268.16 crore in the prior year. Revenue from operations for the six-month period was 2,078.78 crore. The auditors conducted a limited review of these results. The company noted an aggregate exposure of 2,559.16 crore in subsidiaries and has not recognized interest income on inter-corporate loans due to prudence.
